name: Architectural Separation Between Observational Availability and Request Fulfillment

tests.description: Recorded initial availability observation (5 ICU beds) into append-only observation store
Submitting 10 emergency bed requests does NOT decrement reported availability (observations remain strictly observational)
Accepting hospital bed requests does NOT deduct from AvailabilityObservation (no transactional lock/hold on reported capacity)
Completing emergency admission does NOT alter AvailabilityObservation time-series ledger
Stale availability reports (>30 min old) are rejected at ingestion boundary

details.error: Current availability must be observed within the last 30 minutes

tests.description: API response contracts explicitly classify submissions as requests requiring clinical confirmation rather than guaranteed reservations
